The qwen model's inconclusive result was due to an API error (HTTP 400), not a security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement (inconclusive vs safe) was caused by a tool failure in the qwen model, which encountered an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD. This is not a substantive security disagreement but rather a coverage gap due to API failure.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete PKGBUILD audit due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: API errors should be retried or escalated to a fallback model rather than producing an inconclusive verdict that triggers unnecessary re-audits
